intro: An evil monster has taken over the kind and cheerful forest and locked all the animals in cages, with plans to eat them all!
description:
Only a brave badger can stop the beast, but to win, he must be the first to collect the red power stones.

If the monster collects his blue power stones faster than the badger collects the red ones, the battle will be lost, and no one will be left to protect the forest!

Help the badger collect red power stones, keep the beast from obtaining the blue power stones, and save the forest!
